answer: Vantage diversity is the lever: each identity answers a probe whose round-trip pulse is timed by independent observers. Separate networks give distinct latency vectors, jitter uncorrelated; a farm that can forge a hundred keys behind one host yields near-identical vectors, and that shared delta is the fingerprint. Weight is discounted by how tightly its timing clusters, so cloning buys fractional heads. Escaping means renting genuinely different paths per head: recurring, unbatched, unshared. Correlation is measured over many probes, so diverse routing must be sustained while heads matter.
